title: Kitchen Line Champion
style: Dance-pop with big band swagger and punchy drum-driven groove; syncopated verses ride clipped bass, brushed snare, and staccato brass hits; pre-chorus strips to handclaps, toms, and a rising horn swell; chorus opens with full band brass stabs, four-on-the-floor kick, and gang vocal chants. Lead vocal is close-mic and breathy in verses, doubled and shouted on hooks with short delay throws; quick risers, paddle-click percussion, and cymbal swells mark transitions. Bright, glossy, stadium-wide mix., smooth, exciting, big band
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I lace up early
Courts still wet
Coffee and banana
I count my reps
Two hours serves
Then a few soft dinks
I stretch my calves
And I clear my thoughts

[Pre-Chorus]
Seven hours sleep
My body knows
Greek yogurt, berries
Then off I go
One more drill set
One more clean cut
Heart in my throat
But I trust the work

[Chorus]
I’m ready now
I’m ready now
Grand tournament
I’m ready now
I ate right
I rested up
I brought my game
And I showed up

[Verse 2]
No late nights
No heavy meals
Chicken, rice, water
That’s the deal
Footwork first
Then kitchen touches
Third-shot drops
Until the sun hushes
My hands shake
When the bracket posts
Then I breathe in
And I want it most

[Pre-Chorus]
Seven hours sleep
My body knows
Greek yogurt, berries
Then off I go
One more drill set
One more clean cut
Heart in my throat
But I trust the work

[Chorus]
I’m ready now
I’m ready now
Grand tournament
I’m ready now
I ate right
I rested up
I brought my game
And I showed up

[Bridge]
Crowd gets loud
My name in waves
I’ve earned this floor
I’ve earned this stage
One deep breath
Then I go
Split step sharp
And the whole match slows

[Final Chorus]
I’m ready now
I’m ready now
Grand tournament
I’m ready now
I ate right
I rested up
I brought my game
And I showed up

I’m ready now
I’m ready now
Grand tournament
I’m ready now
I fought the nerves
I did the work
And when it counted
I won first serve
